skill.name: woocommerce-markdown
skill.description: Creates and revises WooCommerce Markdown using project-specific structure, formatting, and markdownlint conventions.
skill.summary: Produce consistent WooCommerce documentation that follows repository Markdown standards.
skill.author: woocommerce

security_audit.summary: Eighty-three alerts are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code, placeholder links, a relative link example, and a PHP method name. One medium-risk command is confirmed because the cleanup pipeline removes line breaks before replacing the original file.

remediation.issue: The control-character cleanup pipeline can remove line breaks and overwrite the original Markdown file.
remediation.suggestion: Preserve line breaks, write to a separate output file, review the result, and require a backup before replacing the source.

static_findings.snippet: 1. **Always lint after changes** - Run `markdownlint --fix` then `markdownlint` to verify
2. **Run from repository root** - Ensures `.markdownlint.json` config is loaded
The project uses markdownlint with these specific rules (from `.markdownlint.json`):
- **MD003**: Heading style must be ATX (`# Heading` not `Heading\n===`)
- Use ATX style (`#`) not underline style
Use the `process_order()` method to handle orders.
The `$order_id` parameter must be an integer.
- Most markdown issues are auto-fixable with `markdownlint --fix`

content.user_title: Create WooCommerce Markdown That Passes Lint
content.value_statement: Inconsistent Markdown creates lint failures and slows documentation reviews. This skill applies WooCommerce formatting rules and provides a repeatable validation workflow.
actual_capabilities: Applies WooCommerce heading, list, code block, and whitespace conventions.
Formats links, tables, emphasis, and UTF-8 directory trees.
Adds language identifiers and spacing around fenced code blocks.
Explains common markdownlint failures and their corrections.
Guides markdownlint auto-fix and verification from the repository root.
Adapts structure for README, changelog, and CLAUDE.md files.
limitations: It does not install markdownlint or other repository dependencies.
It cannot replace the repository configuration as the final authority.
Automated fixes cannot resolve every structural or language-label issue.
The control-character cleanup command can remove line breaks and requires a backup.

use_cases.title: Prepare Contributor Documentation
use_cases.description: Create or revise WooCommerce guides before review and lint validation.

use_cases.title: Standardize Repository Files
use_cases.description: Align README and CLAUDE.md files with shared formatting conventions.

use_cases.title: Polish Release Notes
use_cases.description: Format changelog entries with consistent headings, dates, and change groups.

prompt_templates.title: Format a New Document
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a WooCommerce README for [component] with installation, usage, and testing sections. Follow the repository Markdown rules.

prompt_templates.title: Fix Existing Markdown
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise [file] to satisfy WooCommerce markdownlint conventions. Preserve meaning and summarize every formatting change.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Documentation Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [document] for heading hierarchy, list indentation, code languages, links, tables, and spacing. Return prioritized corrections.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review a complex document for consistency.

prompt_templates.title: Restructure AI Instructions
prompt_templates.prompt: Reorganize [CLAUDE.md content] for reliable AI parsing. Preserve requirements, add navigation, and identify conflicting instructions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve a large AI guidance document.

output_examples.input: Review this README for WooCommerce Markdown compliance.
output_examples.output: Corrected heading levels, added code languages, fixed nested list indentation, and inserted required blank lines. The document is ready for markdownlint verification.

output_examples.input: Create a changelog entry for the new checkout validation.
output_examples.output: Added a concise dated entry under the appropriate change group, using consistent headings and scannable release language.

output_examples.input: Improve this CLAUDE.md file for AI parsing.
output_examples.output: Reorganized requirements into a clear hierarchy, added navigation, removed repeated guidance, and preserved all project-specific instructions.

best_practices: Run markdownlint from the repository root so the project configuration is loaded.
Preserve the document meaning while making formatting corrections.
Review auto-fixed content and verify a clean lint result before committing.
anti_patterns: Do not skip heading levels or replace headings with emphasized text.
Do not use unlabeled code fences or inconsistent list indentation.
Do not overwrite a source file with cleanup output before reviewing a backup.

faq.question: Which files does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports WooCommerce Markdown, including README, changelog, documentation, and CLAUDE.md files.

faq.question: Does it run markdownlint automatically?
faq.answer: It provides the workflow and commands. Tool execution depends on the active agent and user permissions.

faq.question: Does it install markdownlint?
faq.answer: No. The repository must already provide markdownlint and its required dependencies.

faq.question: Can it fix every lint error?
faq.answer: No. Language labels, content structure, and some formatting problems require manual review.

faq.question: Must commands run from the repository root?
faq.answer: Yes. This ensures markdownlint loads the WooCommerce project configuration.

faq.question: Is the control-character cleanup command safe?
faq.answer: Not without safeguards. It can remove line breaks, so create a backup and review separate output first.
